title: Agreement Tenure Concession on Protected Substitute Prices (Contract Pricing Agreement)
content:
## Agreement tenure concession on a protected substitute price — Contract Pricing Agreement

The tenure concession follows the whole months from the agreement's proposal date, as the agreement record shows it, to the handling date. Whole months between two dates are the difference in calendar months between them, less one when the later date's day of the month is earlier than the earlier date's.

- 24 or more whole months: 0.5 percent off.
- At least 12 and fewer than 24 whole months: 0.25 percent off.
- Fewer than 12 whole months: nothing off.

An amount equal to that percent of the protected price is taken off the protected price before its rounding to four decimal places.

Counting example (hypothetical dates): proposal dated 15 January, handled on 14 January two years later — 24 calendar months, less one because the 14th is earlier than the 15th, so 23 whole months and 0.25 percent off.
